description:
Starts a run of a BearQ workflow now and returns the run (id, status, timestamps). If a run of that workflow is already in flight, no new run is started and the in-flight run is returned with started: false. Poll the run's progress with bearq_get_workflow_run.

**Toolset:** Workflows

**Parameters:**
- workflow (string) *required*: Workflow to run: its name (case-insensitive) or its numeric workflow ID.

workflow.description: Workflow to run: its name (case-insensitive) or its numeric workflow ID.

name: bearq_run_workflow
title: BearQ: Run Workflow
